hero.title: Rebuilding Haiti with dignity and hope
hero.subtitle: A long-term, people-first movement uniting Haitians at home and abroad to restore communities, infrastructure, and opportunity.

about.title: Who we are
about.body: New Haiti 2075 is a community-driven initiative focused on long-term reconstruction and renewal in Haiti. We connect leaders, volunteers, and partners around concrete projects that restore dignity, strengthen communities, and build a future rooted in justice and hope.

mission.title: Our mission
points: Restore dignity and opportunity in Haitian communities through concrete, long-term projects.
Mobilize Haitians at home and in the diaspora to work together with trust and transparency.
Invest in education, health, infrastructure, and local leadership for lasting impact.

projectsSection.title: Key project areas
projectsSection.subtitle: From basic infrastructure to education and health, each project area is designed to bring real, visible change on the ground.

newsletter.title: Stay connected to the movement
newsletter.subtitle: Receive updates about projects, stories from the field, and ways to support New Haiti 2075.
newsletter.successMessage: Thank you for subscribing! We’ll keep you updated with new stories and progress.

footer.tagline: Rebuilding Haiti with dignity, hope, and unity.

legal.disclaimer: New Haiti 2075 is a community-driven initiative dedicated to long-term reconstruction, empowerment, and sustainable development for the people of Haiti.
